bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
fixture=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.worktrees/g3-semantic/.debugai-input/unicode-search-source-slice
[ -d "$fixture" ] || { echo DEBUGAI_FIXTURE=NOT_PRESENT; exit 3; }
echo DEBUGAI_FIXTURE=FOUND
find "$fixture" -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path '*/.git/*' -printf '%P\n' | sort | head -n 20
testfile="$fixture/unicode-search.test.cjs"
if [ -f "$testfile" ]; then

else echo DEBUGAI_TEST_FILE=NOT_FOUND; fi
